run.command: if git diff --cached --no-ext-diff --no-textconv --no-color --unified=0 | awk '/^diff --git / { h = 0 } /^@@ / { h = 1; next } h && /^\+/ { print substr($0, 2) }' | grep -E '(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(-----BEGIN ((RSA|EC|DSA|OPENSSH|ENCRYPTED) )?PRIVATE KEY-----|(AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{82})([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)' >/dev/null; then echo 'staged changes look like they contain a secret'; exit 2; fi; exit 0
